articleTitle: Decentralized E-voting system based on Smart Contract by using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Nowadays the use of the Internet is growing; E-voting system has been used by different countries because it reduces the cost and the time which used to consumed by using traditional voting. When the voter wants to access the E-voting system through the web application, there are requirements such as a web browser and a server. The voter uses the web browser to reach to a centralized database. The use of a centralized database for the voting system has some security issues such as Data modification through the third party in the network due to the use of the central database system as well as the result of the voting is not shown in real-time. However, this paper aims to provide an E-voting system with high security by using blockchain. Blockchain provides a decentralized model that makes the network Reliable, safe, flexible, and able to support real-time services.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Baby Cradle System using Raspberry Pi B+
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: This paper presents IoT based smart system that act as baby cradle monitoring system for engaged or working parent so that they can manage properly, and also for proper care and safety of the infant. Parent can recognize baby's movement, sound like crying and video output of baby's present position and motion will be visible on a screen monitor so the parent or any person can watch the infant even while away from baby. This cradle system is useful for monitoring or detecting movement and crying condition of the child automatically. The Raspberry pi B + module is used to have control on the entire hardware, condenser MIC is implemented for baby cry detection, PIR motion sensor is designed to identify baby's motion and pi camera is capturing the infant condition of motion and the display is used to show video output of sleeping baby. This smart baby monitoring system have n number of parameters such as live video and sound, set down audio and leisure movement of infant, measuring the room temperature and the humidity indicates if the baby is sleepless, and the most important characteristic is the ability to listen to the baby noise with cry detection feature.

articleTitle: NIDS-Network Intrusion Detection System Based on Deep and Machine Learning Frameworks with CICIDS2018 using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Currently Machine-learning (ML) methods are widely active in this era of information security. Owing to unpredictable actions and unknown vulnerabilities, conventional security strategies based on rules remain vulnerable to sophisticated attacks. ML techniques enable us to develop IDS-Intrusion Detection Systems focused upon finding of anomalies rather than detection of misuse. In addition, threshold problems in detecting anomalies can also be overcome by machine-learning. Like the malicious code datasets, there are relatively few data sets for network intrusion detection. KDDCUP-99 remains the dataset most utilized for IDS assessment. Numerous experiments on ML-Machine Learning based IDS utilizing KDD or enhanced KDD models. Dataset CSE-CICIDS-2018, is used in this paper which contains the most cutting-edge basic system threats. We employ an Intrusion Detection System with Machine Learning Based (Random Forest) for CSE-CIC-IDS-2018 provides an exceptional score with Accuracy score 99%.

articleTitle: Detection of Depression in Social Media via Twitter Using Machine learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In recent year’s social media platforms plays a crucial role in our daily life. The content which share by users on social media replicate the user’s internal life. Folks wish to share daily life incidence like happy moments, joyful memories, and unhappiness on social media. These social network sites widely used for scientist to spot the principles of depression and observe them. Social media provides a new chance to remodel early depression intervention services mostly in young adults. The aim is to develop a project in which system is capable and analyze the syntactical markers related to onset and perpetual symptoms of depression. By using this system it is possible to develop an algorithm which predicts depression in effective manner to put out the approach that syntactical markers used in tweets are often utilized to frame statistical model which will effectively find and also predict depression in such a way that can integrate and extend ancient method of identification.

articleTitle: Different Types of Phishing Attacks and Detection Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In this paper a review has been taken on different types of phishing attacks and detection techniques. Most of the cyber attacks are spreading through users weaknesses, which makes user weakest elements in security chain. Mostly this phishing targets the vulnerability which is already in the system due to human factor. Phishing is the huge problem and there is no single solution for mitigating the vulnerability completely so one has to use number of techniques to mitigate the attack. Here we presented various categories of mitigation technique for the phishing website like detection, correction, prevention and offensive defense.

articleTitle: Land Registry Management using Blockachain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Land Registration is a use case which involves lot of middlemen and central authorities in the process which then puts trust in the system. Keeping traces of who owns which part of land is challenging when there are hundreds or thousands of land records to maintain. Using Blockchain will remove the middlemen in the system and also will reduce corruption and increase speed of the process. Land Registration is a simple decentralized application which is build using the Ethereum Blockchain principals. We can use this registration procedure as an substitute to bypass the existing system flaws. Here the user who owns the land registers his land details and also enters market value of the land by providing all the necessary proofs. A government authority who traditionally looks into land registry is assigned as a super admin can do the registration process. Lands coming under a particular village can be registered to the system only through the super admin who is assigned to that village. The smart contract used here is written in such a way that the owner has to transfer his property completely to the buyer and no transaction of the land can be partial. Even we allow a government authority is involved in registration process, the entire process is transparent and the transaction happens only between the two clients.

articleTitle: Social Media Analytics during Pandemic for Covid19 using Topic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The entire world is facing the Covid19 pandemic. This pandemic has various consequences on the political, cultural, economical and social life of the community. Lockdown has affected the psychological impact on society. This is reflected in various social media sites. In such a phase social media analytics for twitter data can be useful for understanding public opinion. In this paper, we have applied the Latent Dirichlet Allocation Algorithm as a topic modeling algorithm. Topic modeling finds the main theme that pervades the large data set. Twitter media is considered as the most popular microblogging platform, hence data during this pandemic is extracted from twitter. Natural language processing Techniques applied as preprocessing and then topic modeling applied which has given satisfactory results in terms of perplexity as a performance measure. Topic extracted gives an idea of the impact of Covid19 on society through their opinion on twitter. This can be helpful for making future policies by policymakers.

articleTitle: Real Time Emotion Recognition and Gender Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The proposed prototype aims to classify the gender and the emotions of a person in real time or using the image of the person in smartphone or hard copy of the photograph. The gender classification would be implemented by simple yet robust real time convolutional neural network. Whereas for the emotion recognition, instead of fully connected layers, this model boasts and consists of depth wise separable convolution. It not only reduces the number of parameters and computation utilized in convolution but further increasing the efficiency. It has proved to achieve success in image classification models in terms of both, i) in obtaining better models than previously possible for a given parameter count required to perform at a given level and ii) acquire state-of-the-art results. The output is provided in the form of classes and these are seven classes of emotion recognition (angry, fear, sad, happy, surprise, neutral, disgust) and two classes of gender classification (Male and Female). The present accuracy for gender classification is 95%, whereas the accuracy for facial emotion recognition is around 67%. Also, a large reduction of hyperparameters is the main goal to reduce the model size.

articleTitle: A distortion-free watermarking approach for verifying integrity of relational databases
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Due to high availability and easy accessibility of information, it has become quite difficult to assure security of data. Even though watermarking seems to be an effective solution to protect data, it is still challenging to be used with relational databases. Moreover, inserting a watermark in database may lead to distortion. As a result, the contents of database can no longer remain useful. Our proposed distortion-free watermarking approach ensures that integrity of database can be preserved by generating an image watermark from its contents. This image is registered with Certification Authority (CA) before the database is distributed for use. In case, the owner suspects any kind of tampering in the database, an image watermark is generated and compared with the registered image watermark. If both do not match, it can be concluded that the integrity of database has been compromised. Experiments are conducted on Forest Cover Type data set to localize tampering to the finest granularity. Results show that our approach can detect all types of attack with 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Thermal Face Recognition using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Face recognition is the process of identifying the human face with the help of computerized system mostly for the purpose of security reasons. As the face is very important characteristic of human body through which one can uniquely identify the person. So focusing the face for authentication or identification is at most important for variety of its applications. It is the problem of pattern recognition which can be easily and efficiently solved with artificial neural networks (ANN). Pattern recognition is the process through which particular patterns can be identified, recognized based on the relatedness and similarities between the patterns. Face recognition is having number of applications such as authentication at various offices, organizations or other sectors where security is of utmost important. The proposed methodology for face recognition made use of visible, thermal and fused image database. Thermal imaging detects the heat of the object or face. The artificial neural network is a very efficient technology to enhance the results. Here backpropagation and Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm were compared by using the same database. The Backpropagation algorithm achieved the accuracy of 92.86% and for Levenberg-Marquardt accuracy is 83.92%.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection and Prevention By Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Internet banking is now becoming the most commonly used form of banking transactions. Confidentiality can be compromised in the process of electronic purchases. We therefore introduced a new approach to prevent theft during online transactions in order to protect information through a two-step mechanism of authentication. The primary step of authentication is OTP verification. If the OTP has been checked, the face should be recognized. The details are collected and the authorization for both true and fraudulent transactions is submitted to the bank. The new credit card scanning device has beneficial characteristics such as certain health, user-friendliness, etc. The purpose of the application is to reduce credit card fraud by knowledge of the Face System. Customers get the most accessible and highly efficient electronic banking program.

articleTitle: Intelligent Noise Mapping using Smart Phone on Web platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Environmental pollution has become very serious due to today's advancement all around the world. Pollutions are of different types which include noise pollution. Noise pollution is considered as one of the most prevalent environmental challenges affecting human health. The rapid growth of population, vehicular density in roads, urbanization, etc., is increasing noise pollution in cities needing techniques to monitor and predict noise or to determine its effects on health. Noise levels of various sources, when integrated with the terrain data, are playing a vital role in determining the extent of noise pollution at various neighboring locations. The technique is tried to be developed over a typical city in India, i.e., Lucknow, with mixed land use pattern is chosen thus far. Further, an important variation in noise levels exists here from a place to another. It also varies with time in this city. It is planned to collect the noise levels of Lucknow from typically very crowded, averagely crowded, and thinly crowded areas. The collected data are also planned to be characterized as peak hour, average hour, and off-peak hour. Noise intensity and frequency data are observed to understand and characterize noise levels with the full spectrum. Once noise data are collected it is planned to be utilized for prediction of noise levels at unknown neighboring locations using terrain data and noise model. As it was understood that the collection of noise data at all source points is difficult, an intelligent technique is planned to be implemented. A smartphone-based technique is thought for it. Smartphone with noise App is planned to be utilized to collect the noise data, after the proper calibration of its microphone with Noise Level Meter. A web-based application where people will participate and upload the noise levels with smartphones is planned to serve the purpose. The requirement of terrain data is tried to be managed using a classified web map of google. Predicted noise levels over smart-phone are related to various health hazards. People's feedback on health issues due to noise is recorded, along with health check-up reports, and reviews of literature. These are combined to relate to the effect of noise on health for an area.

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification on Twitter and Zomato Dataset Using Supervised Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a special type of Machine Learning that takes care of unstructured data from the real world. Sentiment Analysis is the 'computational' method that decides whether the given sentence or paragraph is positive, negative or neutral. It derives a people's feelings, opinion and attitude etc. Using sentiment analysis tools in Twitter data to evaluate views and attitude which may help companies understand how people think about various events or products. In this paper, we have collected tweets dataset from twitter of hashtag COVID-19 and CORONA VIRUS. For Twitter dataset, we performed sentiment analysis and on Zomato dataset, Supervised Machine Learning Classification algorithms. Random Forest has got highest accuracy as 94.90 %.

articleTitle: Solar Based Smart Irrigation system Using IoT:A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: India have huge land under agricultural, about 58% of peoples are depends directly or indirectly upon the farming; so the agriculture has important role in Indian economy. Now due to huge climate changes, monsoon does not come on time so for regularity of farming it is high necessity of irrigation system. Irrigation increase the farming efficiency and increases the yield. This paper focused on improvement of water management practice in irrigation which are suffering from the various operational deficiencies like load shading. Conventional irrigation system runs on the electricity and the diesel, so for that lots of conventional energy is wasted which can be easily replaced by the solar energy. And automation in irrigation saves the time, energy recourses and most important water. The objective of this paper is to present the literature review from the conventional methods of irrigation to recent trends in irrigation and automatic irrigation presently available in market and some which are under research stage. This paper will also review the comparison between solar based irrigation and the other energy based irrigation based on various parameters.

articleTitle: Current Trends In Bio-Sensing Technologies For Tuberculosis Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Universally tuberculosis is the recordable serious killer diseases produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Today in the medical field the most challenging and demanding job is detection of Tuberculosis. As per the current situations tuberculosis detection methods can be improve by bio-sensing technologies. The various bio-sensors have been developed in last few decades to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The recognition systems of these bio-sensors are based on basic signal transducer principles and various biological elements. The purpose of the paper is to study the severity of tuberculosis and a number of bio-sensing technologies for rapid detection of tuberculosis and also shown different kinds of bio-sensors with their limits of recognition. Categorization of these bio-sensors are constructed on the process of signal transduction specially physical and chemical signal transducer with piezo-electric quartz crystal bio-sensors, electro-chemical bio-sensors, Magneto elastic Bio-sensors, Micro-cantilever Bio-sensors, Breathalyzer sensors.

articleTitle: Spam Detection by designing Machine Learning approach in Twitter Stream
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: As we all are aware of the Online social networking sites that has been rapidly growing very fast in today’s world as there are many popular sites one of them is Twitter, on twitter users tweet in the form of short text messages to their added friends account. Many of the peoples are available on twitter and it is commonly in today’s world, by this the attacks on this sites is also been varying day by day, as twitter has been affected by this attack where fake user spreads tweets as hash tags of the website or links and some other online services, this all tweets in different form becomes dangerous for the original users on twitter. We need to be aware from this type of attack thus by collecting twitter dataset and working on tweets to find the spam tweets that has been posted on twitter by spammers, in this there are different types of public tweets have been collected. To deal with the problem of Spam messages on twitter this can be solved by using the machine learning algorithm like that of Random forest algorithm this includes classification model by which we can easily classify different types of tweets.

articleTitle: AGV based stretcher
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Industry 4.0 and huge demands in automation are growing in this era. Every single machine requires automation which is helpful to increase efficiency and also production rate. Considering such demands, an automated stretcher has designed. In the manufacturing industry the machine or device finds it path to move one place to another place with already set commands has immense demand. The automated guided vehicle has the property of following allocated path. Use of automation increase & maintain the quality, overcome the human error while handling & also increase the efficiency of the work, this tends to economic growth. We have designed an automated stretcher which will move on the given commands. This application is useful for multispecialty hospitals, where large buildings are there, RFID tag can be used to label the directions as it contains all information which is required for say stretcher to move. Through Wi-Fi module we can transmit data related to where patient need to move for checkup & testing. This total time to time movement through stretcher, testing report is stored on the portal of hospital. Through which doctor or any authorized person can see the report of patient anytime, anywhere.

articleTitle: CAN Protocol–Application in Automation Electronics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: This paper, describes the CAN Protocol and its use in different types of vehicles. CAN is known as Controller Area Network, for communicating microcontroller with other devices the CAN bus is used. In the network topology it's a robust type nature without affecting the entire system it detects the fault, also CAN is a massage-based protocol. In automobile electronics the CAN Protocol is used in device format, it is called as CAN transceiver module. In this project, Four types of sensors are used which are alcohol sensor, temperature sensor, fuel level sensor, distance measurement sensor. These are used for prevention and avoidance of accidents.

articleTitle: Voting Method for AQI Prediction and Monitoring Air Pollution using Real-Time Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Nowadays Air pollution is of major concern as it deals with environment sustainability. The air pollution is due to the air pollutants like Nitrogen dioxide (NO2), Carbon monoxide (CO3), chlorofluorocarbons, methane and sulfur dioxide, etc. which are very harmful and hazardous. In proposed work, Firstly the best classification algorithm, among Naïve Bayes, J48 Decision tree, Multiclass Label Classifier, Random Forest and SVM, is identified using US pollution data. SVM algorithm delivered more accuracy among all the five algorithms. Then this model should be applied on the real-time data of air pollutants collected from web portal of aqicn.org for Aurangabad city of Maharashtra state. By using the results of this analysis, the notification will be sent on the registered mobiles and the actions will be suggested accordingly to the municipal corporation and the public.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis of “Aarogya Setu”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Identifying the emotional tone behind text or simply opinion mining is in vogue these days and Twitter has been proved as the primary choice when it comes to analyzing the real live data or sentiments of its users regarding anything such as tracking of seismic activities, flu epidemic, automotive industry, academic researches, etc. In today's world, where most of the data is online on social media in an unstructured and scattered form, opinion mining turns out to be a suitable method to understand the public's views and moods. Our paper aims to study the impact of the alleged hacking of the “Aarogya Setu” application (app) on opinions/sentiments of people towards it using sentimental analysis on twitter data. The key finding of our study is the rise in negative emotions against the Aarogya Setu app after its alleged hacking.

articleTitle: Implementation of VFD Application for Speed Control of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Induction motors are used in numerous industrial applications due to the characteristics and robustness. The performance of these motors matches with requirements of industrial applications. The major issue in designing the system with induction motors is matching with the torque and speed requirement. Several researchers have worked on the torque control method and suggested it control the speed of a motor in the early nineties. On the other hand, another approach is to control the speed of the motor with constant torque. The speed of the motor is proportional to the frequency and it provides the control over a wide range of speed right from low to high speed. In all rotary machine applications, speed is a very important parameter to control. Authors have implemented the control of induction motor using Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) and the results for working of the system with a reduction in power consumption are presented in this paper. The modulation technique for the pulse width of the voltage is used to control the input voltage of the motor through an inverter.

articleTitle: Factors Involved in Artificial Intelligence-based Automated HTML Code Generation Tool
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Automated code generation or automatic programming is a widely researched topic these days. The auto code generation fascinates the young researchers towards this field more than ever. The Automatic code generation is the process to generate the valid programming code in various languages and makes programming easy for the next generations. Automatic coding is to build a machine which can write code. The code writing process involves several wearisome steps tearing down a process into small instructions, allotting specific memory locations or to specify the system interrupts. It can also be able to manage the input-output buffers and many other things. After observing these steps as mentioned above, we implement mathematical routines, a subroutine library, and sorting programs. In this paper, we look closely towards the factors involved in Automatic programming. We studied more extensive programming and code writing process to understand how these factors affect the process and which can help anyone build a better machine for auto programming. As we programmed manually first we observed the process and tried to invent ways to abstract these steps to combine them into a higher-level programming language. This includes the development of interpreters, assemblers, compilers, and finally, the automatic code generator programs designed to operate with the process as mentioned earlier, that is, automatic programming.

articleTitle: Review on Speech Recognition System for Disabled People Using Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Speech has been the catalyst in the human development. Being the natural form of communication, it directly affects the human life. Speech disability is found in many forms. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) can be a very good technology in developing the interfaces that will aid speech disabled person. This research paper gives the review on Speech Recognition; special focus is on Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) System for the speech disability found in persons suffering with Cerebral Palsy.

articleTitle: Retinal OCT Images for Glaucoma
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Optical Coherence tomography is the new diagnostic technique for early detection of glaucoma. This research study represents the interpretation of Optical Coherence Tomograph images to develop a system for diagnosis of glaucoma. For early detection of glaucoma, we collected the OCT images of glaucoma patients.

articleTitle: Burn area mapping in Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud platform: 2019 forest fires in eastern Australia
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Forest fires occur throughout the year in rainforests and deserts of Australia. The disastrous bush fire event occurred during November 2019, and lasted until February 2020, destroying more than 46 million acres of land. Burn area mapping is a major parameter in carrying out mitigation measures and regrowth activities by forest officials or fire managers post fire event. In this study, multi-temporal satellite datasets such as images acquired from Sentinel-2 (S2) and Landsat-8 (L8) missions are used to map the burn areas. Two thematic indices such as Differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (dNBR) and Relativized Burn Ratio (RBR) are implemented on the study area. The entire analysis, i.e., accessing the datasets, preprocessing, and calculation of indices for brunt area mapping is carried out on Google Earth Engine cloud platform. Rather than ground survey, the active fire product VIIRS product (VNP14IMGTDL) is used as a proxy for the actual fire indices in accuracy assessment. Results revealed that RBR showed better accuracy than dNBR for both the datasets (S2 and L8). S2 burn severity maps of dNBR and RBR showed better accuracy than L8 burn severity maps because of S2 having a higher spatial resolution. Thus, S2 datasets can be useful for rapid mapping of burn areas with improved spatial as well as temporal resolution.

articleTitle: Data Analytic Tools An Overview
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The process of extracting interesting patterns from vast database hiding is known as Data mining the choice of best one among abundant data mining tools accessible in the sooqis not easy. A numeral factors demand to be contemplated before formulating a financing in any commercial solution. This article stretches the complete and hypothetical analysis of a few open source data mining tools. The data mining tools and their utilities comparison are conferred here. The paper also discusses about Data Analytics and its importance.

articleTitle: Determination of the best location for setting up a transmission tower in the city
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Mobile phones plays a vital role in humans' life due to day by day growth in the mobile industry. The cost of deploying, managing, and maintaining the network infrastructure is high. For a large area deployment of a transmission tower at the best location to maintain adequate signal strength is a challenge. Signal strength is measured in terms of -dBm. Importantly, the best location becomes a function of the position of buildings, terrain points, ground points in 3D. So, it is required to determine the paths through which the signal can transmit before reaching the user locations. While propagating from a transmission tower, a signal can directly reach to the user. It can also reach indirectly after diffracting around the buildings or reflecting from the ground and wall. The path detail controls the attenuation of signals and is required to be determined. In this paper, an attempt has been made to find the best location of the transmission tower. Determination of best location required terrain data in 3D. In this work, a LiDAR-based technique is attempted using the point cloud data of RGIPT. The algorithm extracts building, ground, tree, etc. using LiDAR data. Then boundary or edges inside them coming in the path between potential transmission tower to the user are tried to be determined. To find the strength of the signal for the desired user location, the algorithm tried to determine all the buildings and obstructions and their edges to determine the paths of transmission of signals. Once the detailed signal path information is obtained, the terrain parameters (distance, difference, reflection contribution, ground absorption, etc.) are determined. These are then utilized to model the signal strength for any user location. The approach is extended to determine the best location of transmission tower for the RGIPT campus. The technique is generic, novel and can be applied for any terrain condition with the incorporation of the Digital Elevation Model.

articleTitle: Automatic Traffic Management and Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Traffic is a major problem in big cities. Modern and technological solutions are needed to automatically manage and control traffic signals to reduce traffic congestion. Traffic creates a problem for emergency services like police, ambulance, fire engines etc. This paper proposes to implement a system that will not only aid in reducing the delay faced by the emergency services due to traffic congestion but also provide a surveillance system.

articleTitle: Python Based Face Recognition for Person Identification Using PCA and 2DPCA Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In this paper we proposed a face recognition techniques based on Principal component analysis and two Dimension Principal Component Analysis using python. Many researcher’s use Matlab software but we use Python because it’s open source and easily available. Python provides many good libraries like Open CV, PIL, and Sklearn to solve the face recognition problem. The size of python is very less as compared to matlab so we can avoid the computational burden and it takes less time to execute the program that’s why we get fast and better results on large database. We have used EIF-I and Face 94 database and we applied PCA and 2DPCA on both the database but we got better accuracy using 2DPCA with Face 94 database.

articleTitle: Temperature Measurement using Infrared Contactless Thermal Gun
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Time and again demands for contact less temperature measuring systems have been surfaced. This paper scrutinizes the concept of temperature measurement using contact less thermal gun that employs Infrared temperature Sensors. In certain applications, it is difficult and perhaps hazardous to measure the temperature using physical thermometers such as furnaces and electronic and electrical devices. Also in some cases like mines and potential positive patients of deadly diseases, the thermal gun has potential to replace conventional temperature measuring systems. However, the findings of the paper suggest that for greater efficacy and efficiency, it is imperative that the sensors have strong and robust power covering larger distances. Induction of strong sensors is set to revolutionize the usage of the thermal gun across the vast canvass of applications. This paper illustrates the Infrared Contactless Thermal Gun as the replacement of physical thermometers to ease the process of temperature measurement and safeguard the humanity.

articleTitle: Naïve geolocation of Urban Heat Islands in Aurangabad city (Maharashtra State) using remote sensing and ancillary data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Industrial growth in Aurangabad has spurred the migration from rural to urban areas, leading to rapid urbanisation of the area. Consequently, an increase in the ambient temperature has been felt. This paper presents a naïve method of geolocation of urban heat islands (UHI) in the Aurangabad-Phulambri tehsils using remote sensing datasets and other ancillary data. The method uses openly available satellite datasets from the United States Geological Survey (USGS) website named EarthExplorer. Elementary image processing, pan sharpening and processing with thermal based information using QGIS, help derive the areal hotspots are identified using temporal analysis. The existence of these hotspots and their reason are outlined after field visits. Finally, mitigation measures are proposed for avoiding UHI.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of GPM IMERG, SM2RAIN-CCI, SM2RAIN-ASCAT rainfall estimates over the Indian Subcontinent
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Precipitation has a direct link to water cycle and remains the primary driver to study climatic extremes. While the impact of precipitation on key variables like soil moisture are complicated to observe in nature and are often poorly represented. In the present work, we validate three precipitation products namely (i) the Global Precipitation Measurement mission (GPM) integrated Multi-satellite Retrievals (IMERG), (ii) SM2RAINClimate Change Initiative (SM2RAIN-CCI), (iii) SM2RAIN-Advanced SCATerometer (SM2RAIN-ASCAT over India). While the IMERG precipitation product is derived from multi-satellite precipitation product (topdown approach) the SM2RAIN-CCI and SM2RAINASCAT are derived from surface satellite soil moisture (bottom up approach). Comparative analysis using daily rainfall data from Indian Meteorological department suggests superior performance by SM2RAIN-CCI product.

articleTitle: A study of SLIDE Algorithm: Revolutionary AI Algorithm that Speeds Up Deep Learning on CPUs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Deep learning is the emerging technology, having endless applications and heavy investment from industries. Deep learning constructs a model from many simple computational layers stacked up, resulting in a deep network. Deep networks empower many applications in different domains.Modern advancement in deep learning have made the use of large volume of data, and problem sizes keep increasing, data sizes grow, models use more features. However, specialized hardware’s are costly and challenging to generalize majority of tasks. It is becoming more challenging for training giant Neural Networks with millions of parameters and managing high speed computational power to obtain state-of-the-art accuracy.In the era of Deep Learning, it is widely accepted that for training models, Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) are chosen over Central Processing Units (CPUs) because of powerful speed of processing. But it deals with increase in computational cost and time.In this paper cost effective alternative to train Neural network on CPU has been discussed. SLIDE (Sub-Linear Deep Learning Engine) developed by Rice University Computer Scientists provides significant performance boosts and cost savings with the help of data and model parallelism and workload optimization. SLIDE is adequate to perform its machine learning algorithms using general purpose CPUs, thus eliminating the need of any specialized graphics hardware.

articleTitle: Design, Acquisition and Collection of Various Multimodal Databases to Increase Accuracy and Level of Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Biometric identification and verification technique is an automated sample detection and recognition system that make use of physiological or behavioral characteristics of individuals. Physical biometric traits which include face, fingerprints, palm prints, ear specimens, eye patterns such as iris and retina. Behavioral biometric traits include gait(behaviour), signature, typing speed/patterns, voice patterns etc. Unimodal biometric systems developed for each of these biometric features are not sufficient for gaining accuracy and security. To overcome this problem, multimodal biometrics are developed that apply fusion strategy of multiple biometric modalities or features from two or more than two sources. When we compare Uni-modal biometric systems with multimodal biometric systems then multimodal systems improves recognition accuracy, security issues and system reliability problems. Various unimodal biometric databases are freely available But researchers are facing problems that there are very few multimodal databases are available developing multi modal biometric. This paper presents, collection of various biometric modalities like face, fingerprint, palm print, ear patterns which are obtained in controlled environment using different sensors to develop multimodal biometric system.

articleTitle: Automatic Soil Testing System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Soil is a vital, living component of the environment–a component that can be manipulated to affect crop performance. Soil contains vital nutrients, NPK (Nitrogen, Phosphorous and Potassium) contents and pH which are necessary for successful growth of plants. But this testing is very painful process for the farmers because, farmer need to bring that soil to testing lab and testing takes more than 4-5 days to complete process. And cost of soil testing is also high so poor farmers can’t afford it so they avoid to soil testing. The main aim of this proof of concept model is to construct a soil nutrient testing kit using Arduino UNO board and sensor module. This project gives the details regarding the amount of macro-nutrients and micro-nutrients present in the given sample of soil. The pH value and electrical conductivity of the soil are also measured. From the electrical conductivity we are estimating the salinity of soil and water drainage in the field. All this information regarding the soil which help to determine the which type of crop that can grown more effectively in same soil.

articleTitle: Enhancement in Cloud Security for Web Application Attacks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Nowadays many application programs are on remote server and accessed through internet called as web applications. All web applications have web services mostly used in integration of business. Web applications are always targeted by different types of malicious attacks. Many users upload their data on cloud so web application security is very important issue. To avoid cloud based web application attacks rules to be specified using ontology. Protégé tool is used to implement ontology. Semantic rules are written to show ontology. Attacks on web services have direct impact on organizations private data. Identity based encryption is used to create master login. System uses publisher and subscriber model to share data among various specified users. The publisher has credentials to publish events with two attributes. The user has a credential to receive events with an attribute. This paper focuses on identification of web application attacks, publisher subscriber model architecture, implementation of publisher subscriber algorithm, ontology logic, how the encryption is maintained with confidentiality and authentication.

articleTitle: Sign Lang age Recogni ion sing Openc and HSV color Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Communication is the process of exchanging information, views and expressions between two or more person. The two types of communication are verbal and nonverbal. Hand gestures are nonverbal method of communication. A more organized form of hand gestures is known as sign. The physically disabled person uses these gestures to communicate with everyone. To design a system that can recognize sign language accurately so that physically impaired person can have communication with normal people is the main aim for this paper. System follows the general steps like capturing the image from webcam, compare the image with stored images in data set and convert the gesture into text which is readable by disabled person. It is done by using HSV color model and Opencv libraries.

articleTitle: Long term water consumption prediction for Mumbai
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Mumbai which is home to 20.41 million people and contributing roughly up-to 6.18% of India's economy is the seventh most populated city in the world. Mumbai is surrounded by a long continuous coastline of 167Km. It gets an excess of 1,800mm rainfall during the monsoon months of June to September. But even after having abundant rainfall during the months of June to September, Mumbai faces acute water shortages in the remaining months due to the ever-increasing demand and improper management of water sources. In order to avoid such problems, we need to predict the water demand that will be required in the coming years so that we will get an ample amount of time to prepare for it and chalk up a plan for efficient water usage. Here we are proposing water prediction and requirements forecasting to enable the actual requirements and storage accordingly. The proper planning thereafter for the water can be done and shortage problems can be eliminated or removed to the maximum extent.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Passive Regenerative and Dissipative Snubber Cells for Isolated S.E.P.I.C. Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Single ended primary inductance converter (SEPIC) plays important role in case of switched mode power supplies (SMPS) and power factor correction unit (PFC) & photovoltaic application. It can be used as buck, boost or buckboost topology and is able to provide isolated output in specified conditions. An isolated SEPIC converter takes extreme voltage burden because of transformer leakage inductance. To resolve this problem permanently active or passive clamping action is required. Generally, the passive solution used as RCD snubber is simply unpractical whereas the charge of leakage inductance is huge. On the contrary, the passive solutions normally provide the separation. In this comparative study paper, a passive regenerative snubber along with dissipative snubber for isolated SEPIC converters is studied. It is expected to enhance the converter effectiveness via transmitting power saved inside the leakage inductance of transformer to the output.

articleTitle: Decomposition and Reconstruction of Signal for Identification of Eye Movement Artifacts (OA) in Electroencephalogram (EEG) by applying Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is graphical representation of Human Being's Brain activity. In short Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a biological signal used to understanding Brain working. EEG is threatened by many unwanted signals which makes data noisy. Such unwanted signals are known as Artifacts. Movement of the eyeballs in horizontal/vertical direction and eye blinking produces patterns that are collectively familiar as Eye Movement Artifacts (OA). These noisy signals (OA) tend to be micro-volts in unit, but contaminate the EEG signals. EEG signal is observed in the frequency range of 0-64 Hz, divided into various bands. The Ocular Artifact can be seen within the range of 0-16 Hz, depending on the source. To knoiv, the Ocular Artifact presence is a time consuming process and also needs a Neuro-Expert. To do this efficiently some routine procedure is a needed, so that automatic detection of artifact zones will be handled by system. This paper explain a method to decompose the EEG signal and then identify slow varying OA zones. After detection of OA zones, one can remove by applying Wavelet functions. [1].

articleTitle: Economical Home Automation System utilizing TV Remote (EHAS)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Home computerization or shrewd home industry has seen extraordinary prominence. Automation of the surrounding environment increases the comfort and quality of life of everyone. Economical Home Automation System (EHAS) has been aimed to support and offer care so as to satisfy the requirements of handicapped plus old aged people in the household. In proposed paper a household mechanization device has been developed which is affordable than the available parallel products in bazaar. In the proposed paper, the motorized approach of controlling the devices in a joined or nuclear family that could encourage the assignments of using the regular method for the control. Wireless control is primary concern for everyone. The most notable and successful development for short range remote correspondence Infra-Red (IR) is used to robotize the structure.

articleTitle: Isolation Enhancement Techniques for MIMO Antenna: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna is currently used in wireless communication application such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Wi-Max, WLAN and UWB. This antenna has lot of advantages such as large data capacity, beam steering and diversity. However, isolation between antenna elements should be higher for a better performance of the MIMO antenna. Therefore, isolation enhancement is one of the research areas where work is evolving. A number of techniques are available such as ground plane defected structure (DGS), Periodic Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) structure, slot and stub, neutralization line, metamaterial, complimentary split ring resonator, cylindrical dielectric resonator and decoupling network. Techniques such as Genetic algorithm and Partial swarm optimization are also used to improve the isolation in the digital domain. By implementing the above techniques, isolation of more than 20dB is possible. In this paper isolation improvement techniques are compared on the basis of different design parameters. MIMO antennas are designed with multiband features, compactness of size, and higher isolation between antenna elements for use in wireless communication systems. This review paper will help in future designs of massive MIMO antenna for base stations.

articleTitle: The various surveillance and detection techniques based on wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In this paper, we describe multiple methods used for surveillance and tracking of abnormalities instead of a commercial image processing system, we build an efficient surveillance system in areas of interest by utilizing internet of things and wireless sensors platform. The kinds of cameras and sensors considered that are to be deployed in the area of interest for monitoring suspicious behavior of intruders and conditions such as temperature, humidity, and fire accidents. Then the sensed data is collected and processed locally then transmitted wirelessly to alert an administrator or caretaker about mishappening in the area of interest.

articleTitle: “Intelligent Energy Management” In College Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Energy Management is of great importance nowadays. After so many years of developing technologies we mankind are facing lots of issues regarding power consumption and its utilization in proper organized way. To use energy in an efficient way it is necessary to focus on its consumption for each device surrounding us. Intelligent Energy Management system helps to monitor the consumption, real time costing of energy consumption, monitoring the electrical parameters, controlling all loads in College laboratory via single web server globally from every corner of the World.

articleTitle: Analysis of Musical String Instruments using k-NN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In musical instrument recognition, audio feature extraction and analysis is one of the important phase before classification. The focus of presented work is on Indian musical string instruments. In this paper, temporal such as Zero Crossing Rate(ZCR) and spectral features such as spectral centroid, spectral rolloff, roughness and brightness, are analysed from monophonic recordings of musical string instruments. String instruments include Guitar, Santoor, Sitar and Sarod. Santoor, Sitar and Sarod are Indian musical string instruments. Classification of musical instruments is done by using k-NN classifier. The system is evaluated for various combinations of features. Using single feature, system has shown 67% best average accuracy for roughness. It is observed that Santoor is having distinct characteristics than other instruments. Sitar and Sarod some how similar in roughness, brightness and spectral rolloff.

articleTitle: Study of Surface Finish and Cutting fluid Temperature by Turning with MQL (Minimum Quantity Lubrication) and It’s comparison with Flooded and Dry Turning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: To protect the Environment we have to reduce the use of coolant in operations of metal cutting. MQL is an alternative method which can help to reduce the pollution related with coolant. In this study a nozzle is provided near the cutting areas at with very low speed during turning of hardened steel. This work studies the Importance of Spindle Speed, Feed Rate and DOC (Depth of cut) of D2 material at the time of turning on CNC machine & TNMG Inserts so as to predict the surface roughness and Coolant Temperature by Using Taguchi Method. In this study Average temperature of coolant can be calculate at the time of MQL Turning. The material to be used for the experiment is of D2 grade steel (High-carbon, high-chromium) which has good abrasion and wear resistant properties having hardness ranges from 5562 HRC and TNMG inserts are used. The output parameters which are used to measure is surface roughness and coolant temperature and the results have been compared to find out the best method i.e., Dry turning, Wet turning or turning by using the Minimum Quantity Lubrication.

Author Keywords: Words D2 Material TNMG Inserts Dry Wet

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Coupling Enhancement of WPT System Using Negative Index Material
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Inductive coupling based wireless power transfer finds several applications such as in the charging of electric vehicles and embedded biomedical sensors. However, the efficiency of the wireless power transfer system is inversely proportional to the distance which can impede potential enhancement. Metamaterials (MTM) which have been found to have several interesting electromagnetic properties are being applied in several domains for performance improvement. In this paper, the application of an MTM slab of dimensions 32 cm x 32 cm to improve the coupling of a simple wireless power transfer system is demonstrated. The MTM is designed to operate near 80 MHz and is tested for different positions between the transmitting coil and the receiving coil. A definite improvement in the coupling has been observed under all the tested conditions.

articleTitle: Blocking Phishing e-mail by extracting header information of e-mails
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In-spite of availability of other communications means which includes electronic messages, social networking applications, mobile applications and e-mail, e-mail is widely used means of communication. These e-mail users receives several unsolicited e-mails which most of the times carries phishing attacks, these are Phishing e-mails. These e-mails carry a mechanism using which the users are unknowingly providing their secret information to Phishers such as passwords of internet banking, PIN, credit or debit card number or CVV number using which Phishers access the important information related to the bank accounts of these users.This paper has described development of filter based on origin-based information of e-mail called as Origin based Filter which blocks these phishing e-mails at MTA or MDA level by extracting header part information of these e-mails using Blacklist approach. The OBF has been tested using standard dataset `Public Phishing Corpus' and achieved 100 percent accuracy of this OBF.

articleTitle: Classification of Network Traffic using Ensemble Methods to Secure Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is one of the newest booming technologies that make computer to mimic human actions. IDS-Intrusion detection system the critical parts used to detect malicious activities. Artificial intelligence (AI)plays a critical role to detect intrusions also is commonly seen as the best way to adapt and develop IDS. Neural network algorithms are growing in modern days as latest technique in artificial intelligence which can be applied to real-life problems. In this work we proposed to detect a botnet attack classification that shows a major threat to the commercial and investment customer services sectors. Framework described in this paper built using artificial intelligence on a practical dataset for cyber-attack (CSECIC-IDS2017).

articleTitle: Investigations on Milling of HDS H-13 with Bi-layer Coated Tungsten Carbide Tool
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: This paper presents a new concept to develop a cutting tool for milling technologies. To enable milling for HDS H-13 material for heavy extrusion and forming tools and dies, a milling tool is a key factor. The tool is consisting of a Nano crystalline tungsten carbide base metal, and innovative coating system consisting of AlCrN - TiAlN Bi-layer. By using the said composition we study the wear behavior of end milling cutter while performing machining of HDS H13 material under wet machining condition. Here we study a technique to find wear behavior of an end milling cutter known as Nano-Indentation. The machining experiments involves of a tool which is Bi-layer coated made up of tungsten carbide, carried at various parameters such as cutting speed, feed and cut depth under wet conditions. Optimum parameters of the process can be found using taguchi method. It has been discovered from results that machined material's surface roughness is greatly contributed by the cutting tool type as a significant factor.

articleTitle: Performance Tuning of Queries in Distributed System using Secure Materialized View Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Data warehouse is technique to collect and process data from heterogenous, distributed repository in distinct manner so that knowledge can extract from it's this information are stored in autonomous system there must be some defined way to access it. To access this information we must consider the time and space complexity as data warehouse include historical data that means data from decades so there must be some efficient way to access it. To enhance query performance different approaches are there like hybrid integration system is one of the alternative where most frequent used data are stored in intermediate table i.e. the space from where distributed system can access data commonly, query optimized techniques, implementation of appropriate data type, minimal time query complexity which indirectly effect to accelerate performance of query. We are focused on materialized view that is the provision where you can store the most recent data which extracted for commonly used query in avg transaction into a specialized space or we say MV table so that later on when query fire it will map with table query and resultant data will be extracted. Ultimately we are trying to reduce access time of query. As rather than going to base table every time it will search in MV table and return to user it reduce the access time of complex operation like merge, join and aggregation.

articleTitle: Digital Image Processing Assisted Active Air Suspension in Automotive Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Since the last two decades, the Active Suspension system has been a major area of research in the automobile sector. An Active Suspension consists of a mechanical spring, a damper, and actuator which is operated by an algorithm using sensor feedback. Spring damps the static load of the sprung mass and force actuator gives the required reactive force to minimize or absorb deflection caused by road irregularities. These irregularities are monitored by image processing to provide prior information of road due to which suspension act as active suspension. Vehicle sprung and unsprung mass is differentiated as a full car model. This reviews the quarter car MATLAB SIMSCAPE model of the vehicle. It also involves only the parameter values and not mathematical equations, which makes it easier to understand the behavior of the suspension body. After a detailed study, it is assumed that vehicle suspensions are inclining towards the active suspension system due to their precise and adaptable force control, lower maintenance, high ride quality, simple design and tractable performance.

articleTitle: Simplex Nanobot for Vigilance Prosthetic
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Various applications are used in variety of security applications as well as surveillance applications. A remotely-propelled bot describes a design of the device with the function of the security system for the house. It will help reduce the workload of people, especially senior citizens and will help keep an eye on kids. In the proposed system, we include a mobile application which can run on smartphones that consists of a user-friendly interface to supervise the house with the help of the device. We also provide face detection system for home security, which helps to detect the intruder, if person is authorized then he/she will get access, else access will be denied. This system can also make use of solar chargeable batteries in order to save electricity. Besides, it also has other features, including basic operations like recording a live stream to keep an eye on anything in the house, capturing images whenever required, controlling the bot using the application, etc.

articleTitle: Program Recommendation System for Students or Coder through View Histories and Feedback Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Now a day's most of the students/coders tries to get help of social media for most of their problems. So the recommendation system is also growing very fast for students/coders also. So these days social media also takes helps of recommendation system to catch the attention of every user. Some drawbacks are there in the existing recommendation systems and insufficient support to the current situations. These issues we try to by proposing the Hybrid FB (Feed Back) technique takes help of current MI system. Existing system does not provide accuracy and flexibility so to address this issue we proposed Hybrid FB technique. The methods used by existing recommendation systems are failed to achieve the accuracy and flexibility and proper recommendations. To overcome these problems recently MI method extends ROSE but it doesn't consider satisfaction of the end user which gives scope for improvement in accuracy as per end users requirement. Here we are presenting HFB (Hybrid FB) method in which we are improving the accuracy by taking relevant feedback over the time again and again and also maintains log of feedbacks based on end users. Our system uses this feedback because of which it can generate more precise recommendation next time for same query with less time for others.

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic peripheral neuropathy using a raspberry pi with the help of temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Diabetes is the one of the major disease in the world. Peripheral neuropathy is the most common form of diabetics. In that it firstly affected to feet and legs and followed by hands and arms. In peripheral neuropathy the most common sign is it changes the temperature of feet and toes. In this paper we discuss about the system that is designed to monitor foot temperature of the person with the help of ds18b20 temperature sensors. This system is designed using the Raspberry Pi for taking input from the user. The project details are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of FMAC Protocol in Healthcare Monitoring System based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In sensor network, sensors nodes are deployed which sends data to the sink node. Each sensor nodes have its own battery and ability to communicate with sink node. Network of such nodes is called as Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). The successful operation of any Wireless Sensor Network primarily based on MAC sublayer which deals with addressing and channel access control. Design constraints like power consumption, scalability, delay, traffic control, packet delivery, throughput and overheads need to be considered in WSN. For efficient and successful working of WSN, it is necessary to have an effective MAC protocol to tackle with these design constraints. To expand the lifespan of the Wireless Sensor Network energy of each sensor node must be utilized efficiently. An efficient communication for transmission is possible with efficient MAC protocol and hence network lifetime can be increased. The functioning and performance evaluation of the FMAC Protocol in healthcare system for varied reporting rates has been shown in paper. The objective of the research is to identify the best MAC protocol in Healthcare System. Simulation results for parameters like throughput, packet delivery ratio, packet drop ratio, power consumption and end-to-end delay are illustrated in a graph. Performance metric and simulation outcomes for the proposed Hybrid FMAC (Federated MAC) are examined with available protocols like CSMA, TDMA and ZigBee. Implementation and analysis of Hospital network has been done for the quality of service parameters with respect to reporting rate.

articleTitle: Removing Labeled Portion from Mammogram Image
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Finding of breast tumor which is cancerous at an initial phase is essential and critical for actual treatment and patient recovery. Mammograms are specifically used only in the breast tumor identification. The images taken as mammogram ensure an ability to support physicians in detection of disease affected by cells normal growth. Each mammogram image is having label or number. The paper is based on removing an extra portion like label from mammogram images. To implement this images are used from database which is publicly available mammogram dataset provided by the Mammographic Image Analysis Society. This database contains images those are having three types of fundamental breast tissues. This implementation contains image acquisition, image de-noising, binarization and removing label.

articleTitle: A new Approach of Heart Disease Prediction system using Data Science
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Coronary illness is one of the most essential human maladies on the earth and majorly affects human life. With coronary illness, the heart can’t drive the necessary measure of blood into different pieces of the body. A precise and opportune analysis of coronary illness is significant for the counteraction and treatment of cardiovascular breakdown. To group solid individuals and individuals with coronary illness, non-intrusive techniques, for example, AI are dependable and productive. Cardiovascular sickness (CVD) is the main executioner worldwide and is assessed to slaughter 17.9 million carries on with every year. CVDs are a gathering of infections of the heart and veins and incorporate coronary heart maladies, cerebrovascular sicknesses, rheumatic heart illnesses and different ailments. Four out of five DVC passings are because of cardiovascular failures and strokes, and 33 percentage of these passings happen rashly in individuals under 70 years old. The primary objective of this examination is to make a model that can foresee the event of coronary illness dependent on a mix of attributes (hazard factors) that portray the infection. This exploration is proposed on various arrangement procedures for AI contrasted with standard execution measurements, for example, exactness.

articleTitle: Modern Smart Sensing Technology in Structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The demands for structural health monitoring (SHM) in common systems, for instance, structures, ranges, towers, dams, wind turbines, and pipeline structures have become the matter of prime importance. These structures are required to withstand various outside weights all through their lifetime. The analysts are studying different types of new and old infrastructures to determine any fracture or damage in common structures. Further, the SHM is offering a strategy for debacle control of largescale structures. This strategy is better than the conventional break source impediment method. Right now, specialists have attempted to take a shot at novel, vibration based condition evaluation strategies, and electro-mechanical impedance technique (EMIT). It is understood that these noticeable strategies give points of interest for evaluating the exact weaknesses of largescale common foundations. At the present time, assessment have been done on the methodologies available to realize their features, advantages, and requirements. Also, the assessment examples and their status of examinations are being researched. The work will direct the specialists working in SHM on utilization of newer innovations for far reaching assessment of fracture of structure.

articleTitle: Reservoir Water Surface Area Detection using Satellite observations for synthetic SWOT data simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Water surface extent offers crucial information for reservoir operation management and studies on impact of hydrometeorological changes on reservoir capacity. However, obtaining the water extent using ground observation is not feasible at remote locations. The satellite observations in visible, infrared, and microwave spectrum have high potential in the delineation of water bodies. But each of these products have their own advantages and disadvantages. Therefore, in this study, we evaluate the performance of Landsat-8 and Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data to extract reservoir water extent in India. This data is also a crucial component for studies on the future Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) mission which will be launched next year.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis of Single and Double Layer Wall Configurations for Effective Smart Buildings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: With the ongoing requirement of smart structures and buildings, it is more so important to create buildings which are not just structurally efficient, but also thermally efficient. In this work, we compare the different configuration of materials which can be used to build the walls of the smart buildings to reduce the temperature inside the building and henceforth save the expenditure required to cool down the internal temperature of the building. We use different configurations using materials such as brick, concrete, natural stone, and wood to understand which combination will give the highest efficiency to reduce the temperature inside the building.

articleTitle: Parent-Hook: A Child Tracking System based on Cloud URL
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Child kidnapping, missing child and child harassment are the world-wide problem related child safety. The children of age group 4 to 8 years are innocent and subject to kidnapping in frequent cases. Parents are always worried regarding their children's security mainly when they visit crowded public places and travel in widely physically located places. Number of applications is being developed to guard children in every manner. This paper introduces a Parent-Hook product which is designed for child tracking if the child is lost. The Parent-Hook is a safety band without the sensor or any chip harmful for the children can be put on the whist of the children. This band is easy to carry which is made up of soft cotton webbing with parent contact information with QR Code and Cloud URL.

articleTitle: Novel Model for Detection of Cyber-Aggressive Comments on Social Media Platforms a Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Social networking sites (SNS) provides huge platform to connect people all over the world and share their interests and conflicts. However, Social Networking Sites are also providing opportunities for cyberbullying activities. Cyberbullying can be defined as harassment or insult of any individual or masses by sending or posting messages which hurts the sentiments or threatens them using electronic communication. Cyberbullying causes significant threat to physical and mental health of the victims. Detection of cyberbullying and the provision of subsequent preventive measures are required to overcome cyberbullying. Here we propose an effective model to tackle this menace of cyberbullying on social media. The proposed model can identify the presence of cyberbullying terms and classify cyberbullying activities in social network using machine learning algorithm. The effectiveness of the system can be increased using machine learning to retrieve relevant data for classification from the input. In the proposed method machine learning algorithm can also be used, for optimizing the parameters and to obtain precise output.

articleTitle: A big data compatible naive measure for estimating the landscape dynamics using open geospatial datasets
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: The process of urbanisation has been reported to be a driver of global climatic change. Rapid urbanisation is leading to a drastic change in the land use and land cover (LULC) pattern of any urban area. Urban LULC dynamics can be understood through the use of multi-temporal geospatial datasets. The existence of multi-sensor and multi-temporal remote sensing datasets enable the understanding of LULC dynamics. In this paper, we take Aurangabad as a pilot project for study.
