Aurangabad is a city located in the Marathwada region of the Maharashtra state in India, and is faced with the juxtaposition of the growing industry and the cultural heritage. The city has has been included in the list of 100 smart cities to be developed in India, by the Indian government. This paper proposes a new metric and area based method for the measurement of urban dynamics, and identification of hotspots. The superiority of the metric with respect to the Shannon's Entropy is also illustrated. The approach demostrated in this paper is extendable to the measurement of LULC dynamics and hotspot identification in a Big Data environment as well.

articleTitle: A Review on Techniques, Characteristics and approaches of an intelligent tutoring Chatbot system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Today is the age of Advancement in the various types of machines or devices. And due to this advance. Attribute the difference between human and machine decrease. And the technology, of the computer-based learning system, are integrating more towards Advance tools and technologies like (A.I, N.L.P.)”, such a system is known as an intelligent-tutoring system or conversation system, like a chatbot. It is necessary that with rapidly changing technology, teaching and learning methods of the education system should adapt to increase and enhance the capabilities of teachers and abilities of the students. Therefore, the intelligent tutoring system (Chatbot) using natural language which allows humans to interact with a computer is one of the best alternatives of these requirements where the human tutor is replacing with a virtual tutor. Nowadays, an intelligent tutoring system(Chatbots) are in high demands in our various fields like teaching and learning in education, business, e-comm, online trading, public health care, and sports etc. Different techniques and processes are involved in designing and developing chatbots. This review paper aims to take a survey of the critical and necessary methods used in this communication and conversational agents.

Author Keywords: machine learning (ML) or natural language processing (N.L.P.). Intelligent tutoring system (ITS)

articleTitle: Land Registration System Using Block-chain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In the traditional Land Registration system practiced in India, there exists a middle man (broker) who establishes a contact between the buyer and seller, for instance if an individual wants to buy or sell a property, the broker will create and assemble all the obligatory physical documents with regards to an agreement as a proof of property. Brokers will ensure that the land/property would be registered by an authorised government office where all the attributes are noted down in a ledger and thereafter the whole transaction and purchasement between the two parties takes place. In this scenario, there are chances of losing or tampering of the documents as anyone with certain powers can access or alter the papers easily which in turn threatens this concrete proof of land. Thus, this type of system as compared to our proposed system in which we make use of a smart contract to deal with the assets and transactions among the participants, is relatively time consuming, less secure and unsynchronized where activities including corruption and fraudulence might be associated during the execution of the required process. With an amalgam of inspection and analysis regarding the old accustomed way and considering that Blockchain has an increased transparency and integrity maintenance along with the portability factor, we put forward a blockchain based land registration system which provides a transparent, secured and decentralised method for execution of transactions between the participants by employing the concept of hyper ledger.

articleTitle: Smart Home Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Smart Home System involves controlling home appliances using the Internet of Things (IoT) allowing us to have a user-friendly home automation system. It allows us to auto control electronic appliances in the house such as fans, lights, gates, doors, windows, and many more including security access systems and alarm systems. In this paper, we have implemented the operation of lights through the voice-controlled home automation system by giving voice commands as an input to the system for the user to turn ON and turn OFF the lights at home. The system mainly uses the Raspberry Pi module, which happens to be an important component of our smart light system implementation. It consists of both hardware and software components, which have a speech recognition module implemented using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and has voice commands that can be understood, and accordingly, lights can be operated with its usage. It has a special feature that when the light gets turned ON or OFF, it will be ensured to the user through an audio output by the speaker. The main working of a voice-automated system depends on the recognition of the voice given by the user as an input. Raspberry Pi module keeps all electrical home appliances connected through a single interface for complete smart home system automation. Today's modern world is shifting from conventional switches to centralized control systems with less human intervention, as result, the use of manual operating switches is slowly deteriorating. In this paper, we have used voice recognition for operating the home appliances where there is no need to use the conventional switches, and hence human effort required for the system is comparatively very less. Research work on smart home systems mainly aims to satisfy the needs, which help elderly and disabled people etc. in operating home appliances without any helping support from others. The main purpose of our paper is to build a perfect smart home-helper for the users to operate the home appliances easily through voice commands.

articleTitle: A hybrid scalable collaborative filtering based recommendation system using ontology and incremental SVD algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Recommendation system is a dynamic information filtering system based on machine learning algorithm. Recommendation engine filters large amounts of information generated through the interaction of users to web-portals generate the recommendation to fulfill the expectation of the online users. Collaborative filtering is most popular and efficient method to generate the proper recommendation. Current method of CF is unable to handle the most popular problem of recommendation like data sparsity, scalability, recommendation inaccuracy and big error in predication. To handle the such problem of recommendation this research develops a new hybrid CF approach to addresses the problem of CF like sparsity, scalability inefficiency in recommendation improve the accuracy prediction using the incremental approach of singular value decomposition and ontology approach. To enhance the prediction and recommendation accuracy ontology based approach is applied. This approach is decomposed into two parts offline phase and online phase. In offline phase of collaborative filtering method, use dimension reduction technique like singular value decomposition (SVD) and also use the clustering method to form the clusters of most similar users and items depends upon the preferences which significantly improve the scalability of collaborative filtering. In online phase of recommendation the incremental SVD is used to find out the most relevant item to the new item. The performance of the recommendation system is evaluated through evolution parameter likes Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) over the two real word dataset like Movielens and Flixster Dataset. The result shows that the implemented method effective is to solve the problem of user scalability, data sparsity and improve the performance of prediction and recommendation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Retrieval and Re-ranking Efficiency using Hybrid approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Many Image search engines are used to share images on social media websites on different occasion. It became very essential for user to retrieve more relevant image from web as per user intention, To search and retrieve images from web which are more relevant to user requirement we have proposed a new system using user intention and hybrid features of images to retrieve and re-rank images to user so that user can use these images for his purpose. A novel data fusion technique to support text-based and content based image recovery combining different heterogeneous features is proposed. The user need to provide just a single tick on an inquiry image and pictures recovered by content based pursuit are re-positioned dependent on their visual and texture similitudes to the enquiry image. Word-based and pictorial expansions are incorporated to detect user intention without additional human feedback. Expanded keywords helps in extending positive model images and furthermore develop the image pool to include additional related images. A lot of visual features which are both efficient and effective for image search are chosen. The n-dimensional feature vector for both colour and texture is reduced to single dimension each, used for comparing the similarity with query image using suitable distance metrics. Further only the images retrieved as a outcome of text created pursuit and image re-position process are compared during run time for finding the similar images; not the entire database. This considerably reduces the computational complexity and improves the search efficiency. With improved feature extraction capturing textual and visual similarities, the proposed one click image search framework gives a productive robotized recovery of comparable images giving promising results with improvement in retrieval efficiency.

articleTitle: Review on Intelligent Spectacles to Prevent Road Accident
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: To reduce the road accident rates, the intelligent spectacles are designed that use the deep learning approach to enhance the captured images and process only necessary information. The wearing device will project immediate details of the user's field of vision with the aid of audio navigation and augmented reality techniques. This paper presents a brief overview of the technology adopted by the spectacle throughout this era, their awareness and materials that can be used. Additionally, it includes the objective, the scope of advancement and the approach for implementation of accident prevention. Smart glasses are wearable devices that provide real-time information to the user by using Augmented reality techniques. Smart Glasses can perform complex tasks, run certain applications and provide internet connectivity. Although the future of intelligent spectacles is highly uncertain because of alternative devices' availability and high cost, it is the need for development to change the perspective of usage and limit the resources efficiently. One such approach can be the development of spectacles to prevent road accidents and to overcome the difficulty incurred in previous glasses. We are proposing a potential research direction of creating a model by combining various inputs.

articleTitle: Review: IoT Based Machine Learning Techniques for Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: There are three technologies that highly contributed to the development of our life. Those technologies are Internet of Things (IoT), Machine Learning (ML) and Block Chain. Recently, IoT and ML played important role in healthcare monitoring management through self-management. Self-management resulted in effective treatment in a lower cost. The IoT uses sensors to monitor the patients' health and collect data from patients, transfer these data to ML for extraction, classification and mining, and use the pure data for prediction of the diseases. This facilitates communication between doctor and patient through wearable technologies. The objective is to provide real-time monitoring of chronic diseases such as heart failure, asthma, diabetes, heart attacks etc. So we present a full review of the IoT based ML techniques for healthcare applications.

articleTitle: A portable Hyperspectral imaging system to assess the effect of different nutrient management practices on Chamomile (Chamomila recutita)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Chamomile (Chamomila recutita) is a native species of Europe and Asia which globally cultivated with 8000 tons annual production. It has antioxidant, antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, and has a huge demand in cosmetic, food, pharmaceutical and healthcare industries. Such a high demand can be met through effective nutrient management during crop cultivation monitored for assessment of its effect on the crop health and vigor. Traditional methods of nutrient monitoring during the crop growth phase are invasive and time consuming, hence the use of advanced sensors like Hyperspectral can be an effective tool for non-invasive crop health monitoring. In the present study, the effect of different nutrient treatments including microbial culture and micronutrients on chamomile crop were investigated using portable hyperspectral camera (4001000 nm). Various Hyperspectral Vegetation Indices (VIs) based on normalized differences (NDVI, RDVI, MSR), soil contrast adjustment (SAVI, MSAVI, OSAVI), simple ratio of two discrete bands (SR, GRVI, Red-edge) and three discrete bands (MCARI, TCARI, TVI, SIPI) over multiple nutrient treatments were calculated and were compared to characterize the crop growth status, biophysical variability, vigour, Leaf Area Index (LAI) and pigments like chlorophyll & carotenoids. Results show that Renormalized difference vegetation index (RDVI) and Normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) are best for discriminating amongst different nutrient management practices. The study illustrates the usage of portable Hyperspectral sensor as an effective non-invasive instrument for nutrient management and crop health assessment.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of audio and video processing based on Zedboard
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Field Programable Gate Array (FPGA) implementation of audio and video processing based on Zedboard as a target platform. The Design for the audio system was implemented by verifying various audio files. Verification was done by hearing it on a speaker accordingly by connecting the stereo cable(male-to-male) to a line in (blue plug) of the board to the audio port of the laptop or phone and speaker to line out (green plug) of the board to the USB port of the laptop. And design for the video/monitoring system was implemented by interfacing the OV7670 CMOS camera module through peripheral modules of the board, VGA monitor screen through the VGA port of the board. The algorithms for the audio processing system were implemented in Verilog, a Hardware Description Language, and the video processing system was implemented in VHSIC (Very High Scale Integrated Circuits) Hardware Description Language (VHDL) in VIVADO 2017.4 as a software platform. Step by step approach to design real-time audio & video processing systems has been discussed in this paper.

Author Keywords: Very High Scale Integrated Circuits Hardware Description Language

articleTitle: Smart City during COVID-19 Lockdown and its Future Impact
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: In the coming century's earth will be the most crowded or populated environments where digital devices like sensors, cameras, and cloud-connected data are spread on every walk of life of human beings with the objective of betterment of human living. Smart City has been playing crucial in a pandemic situation. A smart city can be more effective when we have a predominant data platform and that data can be used in such a crisis effectively. To streamline urban operations, information and communication technology is used by the Smart city. In upcoming days, we can see most of the country will pay attention to smart city data so they can operate centrally.

articleTitle: Analysis of Android Applications to Detect Botnet Attacks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Smart Innovations in Design, Environment, Management, Planning and Computing (ICSIDEMPC)
abstract: Smart phones are now vastly used by billions of people because of their developed features namely details of bank account, passwords, net banking details, details of online payments etc. With current situation of pandemic in the world, everyone is doing work from home. In this situation many are using there smartphones for their work purpose, learning purpose etc. which has made use of smartphone mandatory for many. Feasibility of free application over smart phones makes them profitable targets for malware creators and cybercriminals. Existing botnet detection tools are focused mainly on web applications and their detection. They have limited visibility. In proposed research work, a security application is developed which scans all applications installed and identifies probable harmful applications on user's smartphone. It divides all permissions on every application in a pre-identified category. Based on permission category, risk factor of respective application is calculated. If risk factor/score exceeds determined threshold, user is notified about the risk associated with application. This will guide user about applications which can exploit personal information available on user device in real-time.
